learnings.finding: VOLUME RATIO is the strongest untapped ranking signal. 1212-trade analysis: vol <1x = WR 58.9% avg +0.72% (n=688), vol 1-1.5x = 59.9% avg +1.00% (n=192), vol 1.5-2x = 64.4% avg +1.34% (n=118), vol 2-3x = 73.2% avg +3.22% (n=82), vol 3x+ = 72.9% avg +2.54% (n=48). Volume 2x+ is nearly as predictive as 3-strategy overlap. Currently NOT factored into rank_score.
learnings.action: Add vol_ratio to _rank_score(): vol≥2x = +2pts, vol 1.5-2x = +1pt. This is the highest-ROI improvement available.

learnings.finding: CRITICAL: stage4_short WR tracking is inverted. ret_d5 = (price_d5 - price_scan)/price_scan * 100. For shorts, WIN = price fell = ret_d5 < 0. But scan_history WR was computed as ret_d5 > 0 (price rose = LOSS for short). True short WR = 11.4% (9/79). Stored WR 88.6% was actually 88.6% LOSS rate. stage4_short is performing terribly, not as PROVEN_EDGE. All prior stage4_short stats (L002, L010) are invalid.
learnings.action: REMOVE stage4_short from PROVEN_EDGE set immediately. DISABLE stage4_short scanner (it fires on stocks about to go UP, not down). Fix update_scan_history.py to invert sign for short strategies before computing WR.

data.explanation: ret_d5 > 0 means price rose = SHORT POSITION LOST MONEY
